_about: Curios whose art ships inside the APK (assets/assets/swfs/pets, images/pets). 'asset' is the file base name.
Name/element/rarity come from the Curio Quest Wiki roster (data/wiki/curios_wiki.json), matched to the art by eye.
confidence: high = art clearly matches the wiki name; medium = likely; low = best guess, change freely.
description: wiki text when it exists (source=wiki), otherwise written for the revival (source=authored).

species.name: Caniton
species.description: A toxic hound whose drool eats through steel.

species.name: Pigale
species.description: Its fluffy wool traps gusts of wind that it lets loose in a single burst.

species.name: Tropigust
species.description: Tropigust rides warm island breezes and never lands for long.

species.name: Dangler
species.description: The light on its lure is the last thing its prey ever sees.

species.name: Thermant
species.description: A tiny ant that burns hot enough to melt sand into glass.

species.name: Armordillo
species.description: Sworn to protect its friends, it never takes off its armor.

species.name: Macrobe
species.description: A giant microbe that feeds on stray static charge.

species.name: Batawoc
species.description: It sleeps in skulls and wakes up hungry.

species.name: Penzai
species.description: An ancient stone guardian that has grown a garden on its back.

species.name: Bumblebeam
species.description: Its glowing abdomen lights up the hive at night.

species.name: Cap'n Skelly
species.description: The captain went down with the ship, and came back up again.

species.name: Cocon
species.description: A coconut that trained in the art of stealth. Mostly it just falls on people.

species.name: Drakitton
species.description: Playful as a kitten, fierce as a dragon.

species.name: Hartwood
species.description: Carved from driftwood by the tide, it roams the shore at dawn.

species.name: Ducan
species.description: Ducans have trouble swimming and rely on their special gear to swim long distances.

species.name: Claymore
species.description: Handle with care. Claymore has a very short fuse.

species.name: Flairy
species.description: A spark of sunlight that learned how to giggle.

species.name: Clawsphorus
species.description: Its shell glows red hot whenever it gets angry, which is often.

species.name: Impkin
species.description: A mischievous little flame that loves to play tricks.

species.name: Rosie
species.description: Beautiful to look at, painful to pick.

species.name: Frochkon
species.description: Nobody knows which kingdom it rules, including the frog itself.

species.name: Mander
species.description: It sheds its skin in a puff of smoke.

species.name: Gryphos
species.description: A noble sky hunter that answers only to the brave.

species.name: Gumley
species.description: Gumley is composed of intelligent polysaccharides that fused together to create a unified consciousness.

species.name: Hydragon
species.description: The Hydragon's heads can't seem to cooperate with one another unless they're in combat.

species.name: Vultaire
species.description: It circles over frozen peaks waiting for the wind to change.

species.name: Jack
species.description: Its grin burns brighter every night of the harvest.

species.name: Jellot
species.description: Under that coy smile lies an insidious curio with clandestine intent.

species.name: Thundiger
species.description: Its mane crackles with lightning before every pounce.

species.name: Magmo
species.description: A walking furnace built around a molten heart.

species.name: Mantank
species.description: Half mantis, half artillery, all business.

species.name: Yeteen
species.description: A young yeti whose fur reflects the glow of the northern lights.

species.name: Pelica
species.description: It carries messages, snacks and the occasional lost curio in its beak.

species.name: Penstripe
species.description: Always dressed for the occasion, even underwater.

species.name: Jawroger
species.description: The terror of the seven seas, and of the local fish market.

species.name: Pottor
species.description: It hides inside its pot and peeks out only to fight.

species.name: Toadstone
species.description: Moss grows on its back because it rarely moves.

species.name: Prismo
species.description: It splits sunlight into rainbows, and enemies into pieces.

species.name: Pupette
species.description: A forgotten doll stitched together with a stubborn will.

species.name: Ossilis
species.description: Its shell is harder than the rocks it sleeps under.

species.name: Shado
species.description: It is always right behind you.

species.name: Cathode
species.description: It sings during thunderstorms, and the storms sing back.

species.name: Tiki
species.description: An ancient mask that dances around the island bonfires.

species.name: Nightmaroot
species.description: Pulled from the ground at midnight, it has been cranky ever since.

species.name: Chelydra
species.description: Slow, patient and absolutely impossible to move.

species.name: Wormseed
species.description: Don't take a bite. It bites back.
